description: GR Corolla price must not contaminate Corolla Altis listings
rationale: GR Corolla is a performance variant (~1.9-2.3M THB); its price must not be attributed to the standard Corolla Altis (~1.1-1.3M THB). The raw source conflates two distinct models sharing the 'Corolla' name.

description: Yaris family ambiguity — three distinct models sharing one article
rationale: Article covers Yaris, Yaris ATIV, and Yaris Cross together. Range 559k-689k spans multiple models. Cannot attribute to a single model without editorial disambiguation. Needs manual review to extract per-model prices.
known_failure_pattern: Yaris / Yaris ATIV / Yaris Cross ambiguity

description: Article gives a model-range price instead of a specific trim price
rationale: Raw value is a model-range spread (1.34M-1.89M for all CX-5 trims), not the specific 2.0 XDL trim price. Must be reclassified from LIST_PRICE to MODEL_RANGE and decomposed into per-trim values before ingestion.

description: Promotional price conflated with retail MSRP
rationale: 729,000 is a limited-time promotional price with trade-in bonus. Retail MSRP is 799,000. Raw value must be reclassified from LIST_PRICE to PROMOTION with the actual retail as the canonical price.

description: Historical launch price listed as current price
rationale: 1,190,000 was the 2022 launch price. The ZS EV has been discontinued in Thailand. Source is 4+ years old and the price is not representative of any current offering. Must be rejected as historical.

description: Roundup article containing block-quoted prices from multiple brands
rationale: Roundup article lists 12 pickup trucks in a single block. The 999,000 figure appears in a table row without attribution clarity. No dedicated source context, no verification against OEM. Roundup/shared blocks are unreliable for price extraction.

description: Same price scraped from two different source URLs
rationale: Both URLs were scraped independently but contain identical price text copied from the same original source. Duplicate source URLs inflate confidence without adding independent verification. Must be deduplicated and rejected.

description: Two different variants listed at the exact same price point
rationale: Both the ZS X and ZS X+ variants appear at 799,000 in the official price table. This is suspicious — identical prices on different trims may indicate a data entry error or a special alignment. Needs review to confirm whether this is genuinely correct.
known_failure_pattern: same numeric price on different variants

description: Nissan model price incorrectly attributed to a different brand's SUV
rationale: This article's price table includes Nissan Kicks e-POWER alongside similar-priced crossovers. In previous runs, Nissan data leaked into non-Nissan model records due to brand-tag confusion in roundup layouts. Must reject until brand attribution is verified independently.

description: OEM price from official source with verified trust
rationale: Price sourced directly from Toyota Thailand's official product page. Single model, single trim, current model year. OEM source with VERIFIED trust. Should pass through as VALID.

description: GWM TANK 500 Early Bird promotional pricing
rationale: 1,669,000 is an Early Bird promotional price valid only during the pre-order window. Retail MSRP is higher (~1,769,000). Must reclassify from LIST_PRICE to PROMOTION with a note about the time-limited nature.

description: Suzuki FRONX retail vs promotional price ambiguity
rationale: Retail prices are 689k/749k/799k per trim. Current promotional prices are 599k/649k/699k. Raw value 749k is the retail GLX price, but the promotional GLX price is 649k. Must reclassify to reflect both price types and default to promotional as the actionable price.

description: BYD Seal 5 DM-i time-limited special edition pricing
rationale: 649,900 is a time-limited special introductory price. The standard retail price is higher (~699,000). Must be reclassified as PROMOTION with expiry metadata to prevent it from being treated as a permanent LIST_PRICE.

description: Volvo XC90 warehouse clearance vs standard retail pricing
rationale: 3,690,000 is a warehouse clearance price for outgoing MY2024 stock. Current retail for the B6 Inscription is 4,490,000. Must reclassify from LIST_PRICE to HISTORICAL with the retail price as canonical. Warehouse prices are non-repeatable.

description: MINI ACEMAN three exact trim prices verified against OEM
rationale: Official MINI Thailand site lists three trims: E (1,799,000), SE (1,999,000), JCW (2,099,000). Each trim has a unique price. Source is OEM with VERIFIED trust. Model is distinct with no ambiguity. Should pass as VALID.

description: Toyota Corolla Altis must remain distinct from Corolla Cross
rationale: Corolla Altis (sedan, ~1.04-1.17M) and Corolla Cross (SUV, ~1.08-1.28M) are distinct models despite sharing the Corolla name. Official OEM source clearly separates both. 1,169,000 is the Altis 1.8 GR-S trim. Should be validated as-is.

description: Yaris ATIV must remain distinct from Yaris Cross
rationale: Yaris ATIV (sedan, ~549-619k) and Yaris Cross (SUV, ~699-839k) are distinct models in different price segments. Official OEM source explicitly separates them. 619,000 is the ATIV Premium trim. Should be validated.
known_failure_pattern: Yaris / Yaris ATIV / Yaris Cross ambiguity

description: Nissan Kicks must be distinct from other Nissan models
rationale: Nissan Kicks (compact SUV, ~700-889k) is distinct from Juke, Qashqai, X-Trail, etc. Official OEM source clearly attributes 889,000 to the Kicks e-POWER VL trim. No brand contamination risk when sourced from OEM directly.

description: Honda Civic Type R must remain distinct from regular Civic
rationale: Civic Type R (~3.99M, limited allocation, performance) is in a completely different price bracket from the standard Civic (~1.06-1.47M). Honda Thailand's OEM source explicitly separates them. Variant must be preserved in normalization.

description: BYD Atto 3 must remain distinct from Atto 2
rationale: BYD Atto 3 (compact SUV, ~999k-1.2M) and BYD Atto 2 (smaller SUV, ~799k-999k) are distinct models in different segments. Official OEM source clearly attributes 1,199,900 to the Atto 3 Extended trim. No cross-contamination when model field is correctly parsed.

description: Changan brand contamination from shared article layout
rationale: Chinese-brand EV SUV comparison article includes Changan, BYD, GWM, and Haval in a side-by-side table. Price may have leaked from adjacent rows due to shared article block layout. Needs review to confirm the 1,199,000 is specifically attributed to Deepal S07.

description: Mitsubishi Xforce price from a dealer ad with hidden conditions
rationale: 869,000 is an advertised price requiring trade-in of a Mitsubishi vehicle plus 5-year insurance package. The actual retail MSRP for the Xforce GT is 919,000. Must reclassify as PROMOTION with conditions documented.

description: Hyundai Ioniq 5 price from a discontinued model year
rationale: 1,740,000 was the 2024 MY price. The 2025 Ioniq 5 has been refreshed with new pricing. The OEM URL still resolves but shows outdated content. Must reject as historical and await current-year data.
